capabilities: Start and stop SolidTime timers via commands, modals, and a sidebar Play/Stop button
Edit the running timer's description, project, tags, and billable status
Show elapsed duration and timer details in a status bar item
Automatically refresh projects, tasks, and tags from the SolidTime API
Connect to a SolidTime account using a Personal Access Token
extras: Supports self-hosted SolidTime instances via a configurable API base URL; the README mentions installing pre-releases via the BRAT plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track billable work time against a time-tracking service without leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: Inspired by and oriented towards the structure of the obsidian-toggl-integration plugin by @mcndt.

summary: SolidTime integration that lets you start, stop, and edit work timers from a sidebar view, status bar item, and commands.
